e: Massive powerful herbivorous odd-toed ungulate of southeast Asia and Africa having very thick skin and one or two horns on the snout; the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number; any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills.
The cardinal number that is the sum of six and one; relating to or involving the stomach; the property of being acidic.
